summary: A Georgia list names a tower rocky top in Union County; sources give three elevations, and a radio tower site is listed there today.

evidence.supports: List row for rocky top: Union County, coordinates, and a value of 3051 in the elevation column
The list's note says names for towers numbered 73 and above are the compiler's own
evidence.quote: (For towers 73 and above, names are my creation.)

evidence.supports: Wikipedia gives the summit's elevation as 3,071 feet (936 m)
Wikipedia says the name refers to the summit's appearance
evidence.quote: Rocky Top was so named on account of its appearance.

evidence.supports: Wikipedia's category list files the summit under mountains of Union County, Georgia
Tower-site listing for Rocky Top near Ivylog in Union County, Georgia
evidence.quote: Radio Tower Site – Rocky Top, Ivylog, Union County, Georgia

evidence.supports: The listing gives a ground elevation of 3075.0 feet (937.3 m)
The listing says the site is not owned by the listing company and that space rental goes through the site owner
evidence.quote: This is not an MRA Owned Site. For space rental contact the site owner.

sources.title: Radio Tower Site - Rocky Top, Ivylog, Union County, Georgia

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The list gives 3051 with no unit. The record's elevation_m of 929.9 equals 3051 feet, so the record reads the list value as feet. The other two sources give different figures, and the story reports all three.

notes_for_editor: Three sources, none of which describes a lookout built, staffed, or removed on this summit, so the story covers the list entry and today only. Elevations disagree: list 3051 (unit not stated), Wikipedia 3,071 ft, tower-site listing 3075.0 ft. The listing's coordinates (34.9820833, -84.0036944) are nearly the list's point, but no source says the listed tower and the radio tower site are one structure, and the story does not claim it. Record status and access stay unknown; the radio site listing does not say whether the summit is public.
